newsitem.title: GERMANY: Holzmann Tilbury sale may raise 200 mln dm.
newsitem.headline: Holzmann Tilbury sale may raise 200 mln dm.

text.p: German building group Philipp Holzmann AG expects to raise between 180 million and 200 million marks from a planned sale of its 29.46 percent stake in Britain's Tilbury Douglas Plc, a Holzmann spokesman said.
"We are expecting a small book profit," the spokesman said. "The book value is 180 million marks. The income will be between 180 and 200 million marks."

Holzmann said on Friday it planned to sell the stake as part of Holzmann's bid to reorganise its investment portfolio and the restructuring of the German company. The sale was taking place in agreement with Tilbury Douglas, it said.
"The existing good cooperation between Philipp Holzmann and Tilbury Douglas will not be affected by the sale of the stake," the statement said.
The statement gave no further details.
The spokesman said the Swiss investment bank UBS had been charged with finding a buyer for the stake.
